title.narrative: Strengthening national capacities on youth development and civic engagement

description.narrative: Based on the UNESCO Toolbox for youth policy and programming, multistakeholder dialogues and trainings will be delivered for the design and roll-out of policies, action plans and programmes on holistic youth development and civic engagement, with the meaningful engagement of youth. The aim of this activity is to bridge the gap between non-youth and youth stakeholders and constituencies at national and local level, and to open avenues for them to jointly construct practical solutions that address the concerns of youth and that enable their participation in decision-making. UNESCO will strengthen the capacities of, and facilitate collaboration among relevant stakeholders, to promote youth development and civic engagement at national and grassroots levels, and the meaningful engagement of youth in national and local institutions, processes and programming.
